name: Parallel Reordering of Interleaved Voxel Bits
aliases: Parallel Reordering of Interleaved Voxel Groups
definition: A parallel technique to reorder two integers containing 4-bit groups representing voxels. Specifically, it reorders interleaved groups of bits representing even voxels (0,2,4,6) and odd voxels (1,3,5,7) into a contiguous or specific layout as depicted in Figure 10.
summary: Parallel Reordering of Interleaved Voxel Bits is a GPU-optimized technique that uses parallel bitwise shifts to deinterleave 4-bit voxel groups, distinguishing itself from sequential methods by leveraging SIMD capabilities for efficient volume rendering pipelines.
